clips.title: The story
paras: West of the road to Dun Modr, Ironbeard's Tomb lies defiled and overrun by acidic oozes. A stone statue watches over the outdoor graveyard, where travelers search the slime for lost possessions.

Ironbeard's Tomb overlooks the marshes beside the road north to Dun Modr. A great stone statue, believed to show Ironbeard, watches over the burial plot. Black and crimson oozes have overrun the crypt below, tainting the resting place. Dwarves no longer bring their dead here. Those who enter the vaults search among the remains swallowed by the slimes.
